label: Scroll
description: Scroll on the computer's screen: `args` is `{ x, y, direction, amount, modifiers }`. `direction` is up, down, left or right; `amount` is how many clicks of the wheel (1 by default); `x` and `y` move the mouse there first (optional, in screen pixels); `modifiers` are keys held while scrolling, joined by + (optional).

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: The scroll, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `scroll` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: What happened, in a sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.
